item.title: Lufthansa Group CEO Warns European Dependence on Gulf Hubs is ‘Achilles’ Heel’
item.description: As a nightmare week for Gulf airlines drags on, Lufthansa Group CEO Carsten Spohr argues Europe must reduce its reliance on Middle East hubs to connect with the world.

item.title: How to Enter the Skift IDEA Awards 2026 (and Lock in the Best Price)
item.description: The strongest award entries rarely start at the deadline. Skift IDEA Awards entry process allows teams to secure their entry early and refine the story behind their work until the final deadline in July.

item.title: Samhi Hotels Acquires 70% Stake In Rare India, Announces Growth Plans
item.description: Samhi Hotels’ growth once again highlights the changing landscape of the hospitality industry in India. And for Rare India, it is an opportunity to use strong partnerships as leverage to grow in the experiential travel segment.

item.title: Visit Greenland CEO Anne Nivíka Grødem to Step Down in May
item.description: Greenland tourism is growing, and Visit Greenland’s next CEO will need to manage rising global interest while protecting one of the world’s most fragile Arctic destinations.

item.title: Steady Succession or Seismic Shift? Delta Shakes Up C-Suite
item.description: The changes come as Ed Bastian enters his second decade as CEO of the airline — he could be working to ensure the company’s business model thrives beyond the current generation of executives.

item.title: After Kristi Noem, What Does a New DHS Chief Mean for the Travel Industry?
item.description: With a new DHS secretary incoming, here’s what the travel industry can expect to change — and what almost certainly won't.

item.title: Has Europe’s Cleanest Jet Fuel Plant Got Bankability?
item.description: Making green jet fuel from carbon dioxide and water is no longer theoretical. The only problem is how to scale it to service airlines and meet binding mandates.

item.title: Dubai Hotel Owner Al Habtoor Calls Out Trump Over ‘Dangerous’ Iran War
item.description: Khalaf Ahmad Al Habtoor’s comments carry weight because he is behind some of the UAE’s largest hotels and because he is one of the rare hoteliers to speak out about the war's disruption to business.

item.title: Heathrow’s Flight Emissions Have Dropped 7%, Third Runway Closer Than Ever
item.description: The race is on to push Heathrow’s expansion plans through regulation and planning. But the airport’s case for a third runway relies heavily on sustainable aviation fuel and aviation still faces major challenges scaling the technology needed to decarbonize.

item.title: When the Sky Closes: A Decision Framework for Middle East Destination Recovery
item.description: Iran’s retaliatory strikes hit Middle East destinations’ civilian infrastructure. The region’s $460 billion tourism machine is counting the cost. This paper provides both the diagnosis and the decision architecture for what comes next.
